title: Canonical Picard base change factors through the coefficient comparison
statement: For scheme morphisms f:X→S, j:W→S, h:T→W [def-pc-scheme] and a module M on X [def-pc-module-pullback], let v:X_T→X_W be the canonical top map and q_W,q_T,p_W,p_T the projections [lem-sc-picard-canonical-base-change-comparisons]. For any isomorphism I:P_v P_qW M ≅ P_qT M equal to the specified tensor composition isomorphism followed by transport along v q_W=q_T, the canonical map β_M is the square moduleBaseChangeMap followed by p_T* of I.hom [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction]. This is a factorization of the morphism itself, with no counit or square-conjugacy assertion. The exact statement is lean.statement.

source.place: Canonical underived base-change construction, followed by coefficient composition from Tag 0097.

proof.text: Substitute the equality identifying I with the specified composition comparison. The hom of the composite isomorphism is the composite of the homs. The first factor is picardTensorCompIso(v,q_W,M); the second is equality transport along v q_W=q_T from pullback.lift_fst. These are exactly the final factor of picardDirectImageBaseChangeMap. Its first factor is moduleBaseChangeMap for v p_W=p_T h from pullback.lift_snd. Proof irrelevance identifies the projection-equation proofs. No adjunction-counit calculation is involved.

lean.statement:
theorem picardDirectImageBaseChangeMap_factorization
    {X S W T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (j : W ⟶ S) (h : T ⟶ W) (M : X.Modules)
    (I : (tensorPullback (picardBaseChangeTop f j h)).obj
        ((tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.fst f j)).obj M) ≅
      (tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.fst f (h ≫ j))).obj M)
    (hI : I = (picardTensorCompIso (picardBaseChangeTop f j h)
        (Limits.pullback.fst f j) M ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun k ↦ (tensorPullback k).obj M)
        (show picardBaseChangeTop f j h ≫ Limits.pullback.fst f j =
            Limits.pullback.fst f (h ≫ j) from by
          dsimp [picardBaseChangeTop]
          rw [Limits.pullback.lift_fst])))) :
    picardDirectImageBaseChangeMap f j h M =
      moduleBaseChangeMap (Limits.pullback.snd f j)
        (Limits.pullback.snd f (h ≫ j)) h (picardBaseChangeTop f j h)
        (by dsimp [picardBaseChangeTop]; rw [Limits.pullback.lift_snd])
        ((tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.fst f j)).obj M) ≫
      (pushforward (Limits.pullback.snd f (h ≫ j))).map I.hom
